Census Limits and Territorial Organization

Functions to retrieve official census administrative boundaries, population centers and capitals.

Get Departmental Census Limits of Peru
get_provincias()
Get Provincial Census Limits of Peru
get_distritos() get_distritos_2025()
Get District Census Limits of Peru
get_capitales()
Get District Capitals of Peru
get_centros_poblados()
Get Population Centers of Peru
